source.title: maid-whale turnaround sheet (FRONT / SIDE / BACK), outside every repository
source.note: derived data only; the image is never stored

scale.definition: front view, ground (lowest sole pixel) to ahoge tip

landmarks.name: hem-at-legs
landmarks.note: visible leg top: the hem underside behind its front edge (the knee is hidden)

landmarks.name: hem-band-top
landmarks.note: top of the white hem band

landmarks.name: crown
landmarks.note: top of the hair cap (back view)

camera.pitchNote: from the fluke tip: front/back height difference over its side-view depth
camera.consequence: a point at depth z toward the camera draws z sin(pitch) lower: lowest-pixel grounds and front/back hems are depth-biased, so G7 measures renders and reference with the same code and cameras

findings.title: Tail side differs between views
findings.detail: front and side views put the tail on body +X; the back view draws it on -X (mirrored)
findings.decision: model the tail on the side two of three views agree on; back-view IoU is reported with and without the tail region

findings.title: Sheet camera is pitched, not strictly orthographic
findings.detail: estimated pitch 7.41 deg (fluke tip front/back height disagreement)
findings.decision: G7 compares silhouettes with matched cameras at the measured pitch as well as level

findings.title: Back bow drawn over the back hair
findings.detail: the back view draws the back bow (0.2184-0.4023) over the hair tips (hair down to 0.2791); the side view puts the back hair 0.3218 behind the body axis, about 15 cm behind the waist
findings.decision: the bow is visible from the back: it sits outside the back hair at the waist, the hair tips tuck under or part around it, and the side-view hair depth is kept
